_note: D2: title+author, title with author null, author only, text only. Mirrors the SDK smoke tests. Expect success; author-only passage keeps its author.
assignment_text: Argue whether towns should plant more street trees. Use the sources.

source_passages.title: Shade
source_passages.author: City trees office
source_passages.text: Street trees cool sidewalks and give birds a place to nest.

source_passages.title: Roots
source_passages.text: Tree roots can lift pavement when they are planted in a narrow strip.

source_passages.author: A gardener
source_passages.text: Young trees need water through their first summer.
Bare soil dries faster when nothing shades it.

essay_text: Towns should plant more street trees. Shade says they cool sidewalks. Roots warns that pavement can lift, so each tree needs room. A gardener says young trees need water. Source 4 says bare soil dries faster without shade.
